verified_assertions: C08 owns only platform-local Case, Thread, Run, Artifact, ToolCall and Outbox state; it does not copy ERP, BI, OA or other enterprise facts.

The five Core operations and six employee commands are closed contracts; Tenant, Principal, workload Actor, policy result, Adapter, URL, SQL, credentials and Connector fields cannot be injected by the caller.

Ordinary requests resolve C05 identity, enforce a catalog-fixed C06 operation, bind the decision to the exact identity, resolve C05 again, perform final C03 ACTIVE admission and only then enter a C07-verified Tenant scope.
PREPARE_TOOL_CALL and FINISH_RUN require the same stable Human and workload Principal plus their security epochs as START_RUN; a different authorized Human cannot take over the Run.

Session ID, Delegation ID and per-operation purpose are not permanent Run ownership keys, so the same stable Human can recover after Session or Delegation renewal while every operation is reauthorized.
C06 READ policy, rather than a hard-coded owner check, controls inspectRun and reconstructRun so an authorized manager can inspect an employee Run without receiving mutation authority.
Every PREPARE_TOOL_CALL stores the exact TOOL_CALL authorization evidence; the evidence is immutable in PostgreSQL and included in terminal reconstruction hashing.

A terminal Run reconstructs input, model, Prompt, Skill, knowledge, Tool, policy and result versions plus actor, Tenant lifecycle and Trace evidence; a RUNNING Run exposes Case, Thread, input, versions and pending effects without fabricating terminal evidence.
Artifact versions remain append-only under one Artifact ID, require the exact next version and preserve Case, Thread and kind lineage under concurrent PostgreSQL writers.

Each accepted command commits exactly one state change, one Domain Event, one matching Outbox record and one CommandReceipt in a serializable transaction; partial or mismatched evidence cannot commit.
Idempotent replay returns the original receipt, concurrent duplicate commands produce one durable effect and a lost COMMIT acknowledgement does not repeat the state change.
The independent Outbox Worker publishes a stable Event ID, completes only after a matching acknowledgement, requeues publish failures and leaves completion failures for lease-based recovery.
Memory and PostgreSQL Outbox Ports return one canonical shape; PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED claims, lease versions and Worker identity fence stale completion.
The file-backed C0 Mock persists one immutable receipt per effect key; after Worker and Mock restart the same Event, effect key and receipt are reused without a duplicate Synthetic side effect.
All Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL tables use ENABLE and FORCE RLS under dedicated non-owner, NOBYPASSRLS runtime roles; Case and Thread cannot be directly updated through the runtime role.
All verification data comes from the three frozen F02 Synthetic Tenants; Enterprise Identity, OA, U9, BI and every Enterprise Connector remain C0.

limitations: This evidence verifies only P1 Synthetic product-core behavior; it does not include real enterprise identity, organization, permissions, data, OA, U9, BI or any Enterprise Connector.
The C06 READ relation used for manager inspection is a frozen Synthetic resource; real manager hierarchy, project membership and privacy policy remain P3 enterprise integration work.
Tool execution uses a C0 file-backed Synthetic Mock; C16 Tool Catalog, Adapter execution, short-lived credentials, real readback and production side effects are not implemented by C08.
C08 DomainEvent and Outbox evidence is not the immutable business audit required from C18; no production broker, retention archive or signed audit checkpoint is verified.

PostgreSQL testing uses one-use local PostgreSQL 17.10 instances over Unix sockets; production mTLS, network policy, connection-pool behavior, multi-node failover and managed-service constraints are not verified.

The Outbox Worker and injected Publisher are exercised in one local process plus restart simulations; distributed broker partitions, cross-node leases and production consumer recovery are not verified.
No production capacity, latency, long soak, backpressure, high availability, backup, restore, disaster recovery, rolling upgrade or rollback claim is made.
C09, C12, C15, C16, C18 and C19 remain separate pending work packages; this C08 evidence does not claim their behavior or end-to-end P1 completion.
C08 verification does not approve G1, enter P2 or permit enterprise integration; those state changes require the later frozen stage package and explicit external Product Owner decision.
